answer_1.quote: We introduce the novel task of document-level targeted content transfer, defined as rewriting a document to obey a user-provided constraint ... We propose a novel model for this task which learns to rewrite a source document one step at a time using document-level context ...
datasets: Recipe dataset (≈1.2M recipes from various websites)

answer_2.quote: We evaluate model rewrites on 1000 recipes ... measuring their overall quality, their fluency, their dietary constraint accuracy, and their ability to produce diverse outputs ... Fluency: We measure the perplexity of the model-generated recipes ... Closeness to source: We report ROUGE-L recall ... Diversity: ... proportion of unique trigrams.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human-based evaluation using a crowdsourcing platform ... Individual: We ask 5 judges to rate each rewritten recipe on a scale of 1 to 5 on these criteria: a. Ingredient usage ... b. Closeness to source ... c. Dietary constraint ... d. Overall quality ... Comparative: We also collect human judgments on head-to‑head comparisons ...
answer_4.guideline: Judges rate rewrites on multiple criteria such as ingredient usage, closeness to source, dietary constraint compliance, and overall quality; also perform pairwise preference judgments.
